  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    eps = 1e-6\n    abs_adv = ops.add(ops.abs(adv_gap), eps)\n    ratio = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), abs_adv)\n    neg_ratio = ops.neg(ratio)\n    loss = ops.softplus(neg_ratio)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

It uses a differentiable hinge-like penalty on rank violations weighted by sample advantages.",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    margin = float(extra.get('margin', 1.0))\n    logistic_penalty_scale = float(extra.get('logistic_penalty_scale', 0.1))\n\n    diff = lpw - lpl\n    relu = ops.relu(margin - diff)\n    # Weighted hinge penalty scaled by advantage gap\n    weighted_violation = relu * adv_gap\n\n    # Logistic softplus penalty encourages margin to be exceeded softly\n    logistic_penalty = ops.softplus(-diff)\n\n    if weight is not None:\n        weighted_violation = weighted_violation * weight\n        logistic_penalty = logistic_penalty * weight\n\n    loss = ops.mean(weighted_violation) + logistic_penalty_scale * ops.mean(logistic_penalty)\n    return loss"
